label: Documentation Writing
description: Write or improve documentation, guides, READMEs, or public docs.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to explain, document, publish, or structure information.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for implementation, debugging, or security review.

label: Public Documentation
description: Write public-facing docs, installation instructions, guides, or website copy.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for docs intended for external users or public release.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for private notes, internal plans, or implementation only.

label: Documentation Editing
description: Edit existing docs for clarity, structure, consistency, and correctness.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to revise, streamline, or polish documentation.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to implement code behavior.

label: Summarization
description: Condense content while preserving important points.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a summary, digest, brief, or executive overview.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to make a routing decision requiring tools.

label: Release Notes
description: Write user-facing release notes, changelogs, or announcement copy.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for release notes or public-facing change summary.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal license interpretation.

label: Email Writing
description: Draft clear emails for business, support, sales, or coordination contexts.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to write an email.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for SMS-length ad copy only.

label: Blog Writing
description: Draft blog posts, articles, essays, or explanatory long-form content.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a blog or article.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for terse release notes.

label: Proposal Writing
description: Draft proposals, narratives, scopes, or persuasive structured documents.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to write a proposal or formal document.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal contract review.

label: Style Rewrite
description: Rewrite text for tone, clarity, audience, or style.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to make text clearer or change tone.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for factual verification only.

label: Outline Writing
description: Create structured outlines for documents, talks, articles, or plans.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to structure content before writing.
